name: block_slider_images
title: Block Slider Images
summary: Image slider of a post folder, with popup gallery.
description: Image slider of a post (old slider_directory_images): every image in src/content/img/projects/<media.path>/<img_array_path_dir> (or <global_img_path>/..., or only the files listed in "images"). Sliding, arrows, "i / N" counter and optional dots come from utility_slider; slides open in the popup gallery (same slider). Optional videos (project_block_video) as extra slides that play in place and are part of the popup gallery.
